    private JPanel
    AnahataUpdateCenterPanel.buildUpdateCenterCard(AnahataUcUtils.UpdateCenterType type)
    Builds a distinct, highly visible card for a single update center catalog using a clean 3-column layout: - Column 1 (Left): Toggle button and centered Online/Offline status (vertically centered). - Column 2 (Middle): Name + Trust, Description, URL link, live Maven Central shield badge, and alerts. - Column 3 (Right): 1-Click Update action button with single-line Size & Released metadata (vertically centered).
